events.title: 2026 Iran War / Strait of Hormuz Crisis
events.summary: Active war US/Israel vs Iran + Axis of Resistance. Hormuz effectively closed since Feb 28. Iran rejected US 15-point peace plan. Iran says no decision on return to talks. Trump says Hormuz = US territory. Ship traffic at 3-month low (5-day avg ~13). EIA calls largest oil supply disruption in history. Brent at \.52.
new_developments_24h: Iran says no decision yet on return to talks (Al Jazeera Aug 15)
Trump says he will declare Strait of Hormuz US territory (ABC News)
Hormuz talks stall, oil surges 5%+ (BigGo Finance)
Ship traffic at 3-month low per Kpler data (CNBC)

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic - WHO PHEIC
events.summary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC and Uganda. WHO PHEIC declared May 16. Deaths surpass 2,000 (UN News Aug 13). One death every 30 minutes (UN News Aug 15). 4,660+ cases. Spread to 6th DRC province (Guardian Aug 13). Uganda outbreak declared over July 28. No approved vaccine for BDBV. M23 conflict hinders response.
new_developments_24h: One death every 30 minutes (UN News Aug 15)
Ituri province heart of outbreak: 3,400+ of 4,660 cases
2.6 million seriously malnourished in eastern DRC
